decisions.reason: The position specifies a new automatic WC flush control kit.

items.material_name: 6 V DC two-cable automatic WC flush control kit for concealed cisterns with a 170 × 100 mm access opening, DIN 18040-1
items.description: Battery-powered kit with manual override, selectable 4.5, 6 or 9 L flush volumes, and programmable hygiene flushing; excludes actuator plate.

decisions.reason: The position specifies a new accessible washbasin with an included waste fitting.

items.material_name: 650 × 600 mm white glazed vitreous china wheelchair-accessible washbasin without overflow, pre-scored for one- or three-hole tap fittings
items.description: Includes a wall-installed waste fitting and M10 × 120 mounting screws; specified with KeraTect or equivalent glaze.

decisions.reason: The position specifies a new waste and overflow valve assembly.

items.material_name: R 1 1/4″ swivel washbasin waste and concealed overflow valve, Geberit Clou 152.018.00.1 or equivalent
items.description: For basins without an integral overflow; includes eccentric linkage, chromed valve cup, overflow tubing, union and profiled seal.

decisions.reason: The valve cover is ordered separately as a physical component.

items.material_name: Chrome-plated washbasin waste and overflow valve cover, Geberit Clou 241.993.21.1 or equivalent
items.description: Cover designed to fit the matching waste and overflow valve.

decisions.reason: The position specifies a new basin mixer with an included pop-up waste.

items.material_name: DN 15 chrome-plated single-hole single-lever basin mixer with 150 mm lever and 9 L/min laminar flow regulator
items.description: Ceramic cartridge, adjustable flow limiter with 2.5 L/min minimum, temperature limiter, quick-mount system and 1 1/4″ pop-up waste.

decisions.reason: The position specifies a new prefabricated washbasin mounting frame.

items.material_name: 1.12 × 0.5 m self-supporting accessible washbasin mounting frame for a single-hole tap, with concealed trap
items.description: Powder-coated drywall frame with adjustable feet and tap plate, two R 1/2 water connections, and 40 and 50 mm outlets.

decisions.reason: The position specifies new angle shut-off valves.

items.material_name: DN 15 chrome-plated angle shut-off valve with G 1/2 B outlet thread, DIN 4109 noise group I
items.description: Self-protecting shut-off and connection valve with operating handle and slip-on escutcheon.

decisions.reason: The optional position specifies a new tilting mirror with an included light.

items.material_name: 600 × 540 mm tilting 6 mm crystal-glass accessibility mirror with 28° adjustment and included light fixture
items.description: Includes mounting supports and light bracket; electrical connection is by others.

decisions.reason: The optional position specifies a new frameless mirror with concealed fixings.

items.material_name: 600 × 400 mm rectangular frameless crystal-glass mirror with ground edges and concealed fixings
items.description: Fixed mirror supplied with concealed mounting hardware.

decisions.reason: Position 9.9 specifies new folding support rails with included fixings.

items.material_name: White polyamide twin-rail folding and swivelling grab bar, 600 mm projection, 259 × 78 mm, Ø33 mm rails, 100 kg support load
items.description: Wall-mounted DIN 18024 grab bar with protected steel core, damped lowering, and left or right swivel when raised.
